title: Program ani Source Code mhunnlear kitem?
learningObjectives: Program-acho orth aplea utramnim sangunk ani to computer chalu korunk shaktolea suchonanchem vyavasthit ghotton asa mhunn spost korunk ietolo.
Source Code-achi vyakhya diunk ani to manxam vachunk zata tya Programming Language-ant borovta mhunn vollkhunk ietolem.
Program ani Source Code hancher aslolem sombond spost korunk ani donui utram ekach orthant vaporpachi chuk tallunk ietoli.
Disa-disachem ek kam lhan, spost ani kraman borovillea suchonamnim vibhagunk ietolem.
Soppea udahronnant Input, Processing ani Output hanchi bhumika spost korunk ietoli.
Sadharon bhasent borovillea suchona ani Programming Language-chea nemam pramonn borovillea Source Code hancher farikpon sangunk ietolem.
Bhashe pramonn Compiler, Interpreter vo Runtime Source Code chalu korunk koshi modot kortat tem spost korunk ietolem.
Lhan Code udahronnant suchonacho kram vollkhun dar ek suchon kitem korta tem sangunk ietolem.
Syntax ani spostponnachem mahatv somjun aspasht suchonamni chukicho porinam kiteak mellta tem sangunk ietolem.
Samasye khatir gorjechea suchona nivdun apekshit porinam sangunk ietolem.
Program lhan pavlamnim spost korop, tapasop ani sudarop hache fayde vollkhunk ietolim.
Variables, Conditions, Loops ani Functions shikovpak gorjechi mool somaj vaddovunk ietoli.

understand.concept: Program mhunnlear suchonanchem ek vyavasthit ghotton, jem computer ek kam purnn korunk chalu korunk shakto. Source Code mhunnlear tya suchonanchem manxam vachunk ani borovunk zata tem rup, jem eka Programming Language-ant borovta. Bhashechea nemam pramonn Compiler, Interpreter vo Runtime-achi modot gheun computer Code chalu korta.
understand.whyItMatters: He vichar somjun ghevop gorjechem, karonn Programming shikop mhunnlear fakt Code borovop nhoi; ek samasya computer follow korunk shaktolea suchonamnim bodlop-ui. Puddar Variables, Conditions, Loops ani Functions shikta tedna ho payo upkarak zata.
understand.analogy: Ek randpachi Recipe monant haddat. Ticheant gorjechea jinso ani korpache pavlam ekam mage ek borovlelim astat. Toxench Program-ant computer khatir suchona astat. Tio Programming Language-ant borovlear Source Code zata.
understand.analogyLimit: यह उपमा केवल समझाने के लिए है। कंप्यूटर सामान्य मानव भाषा की अस्पष्टता स्वयं नहीं समझता; Programming Language के नियमों का पालन आवश्यक है।

explain.narrative:
Program mhunnlear suchonanchem ek vyavasthit ghotton, jem computer ek kam purnn korunk chalu korunk shakto. Source Code mhunnlear tya suchonanchem manxam vachunk ani borovunk zata tem rup, jem eka Programming Language-ant borovta. Bhashechea nemam pramonn Compiler, Interpreter vo Runtime-achi modot gheun computer Code chalu korta.

He vichar somjun ghevop gorjechem, karonn Programming shikop mhunnlear fakt Code borovop nhoi; ek samasya computer follow korunk shaktolea suchonamnim bodlop-ui. Puddar Variables, Conditions, Loops ani Functions shikta tedna ho payo upkarak zata.

Computer sadharon manxi bhasheantlo aspashtponn apunn andaz korun somjun gheina. Programming Language-che nem thos astat. Mhunn suchona yogya Syntax ani spost kramant borovp gorjechem.

examples.code:
Problem: Add two numbers.
1. Read the first number.
2. Read the second number.
3. Add the two values.
4. Display the result.

These are problem-solving steps, not yet executable source code in a programming language.
examples.explanation: Computer sadharon manxi bhasheantlo aspashtponn apunn andaz korun somjun gheina. Programming Language-che nem thos astat. Mhunn suchona yogya Syntax ani spost kramant borovp gorjechem.
examples.expectedOutput: A clear distinction between a program's steps and source code written in a programming language.

practise.independentTask: দুইটা সংখ্যা যোগ করबाक Program लेल Input, Processing आ Output के चरण लिखू। फेर Program आ Programming Language में लिखल Source Code के अंतर अपन शब्द में बुझाउ।
hints: সমস্যাকে ছোট, স্পষ্ট ধাপে ভাগ করুন।
প্রতিটি ধাপে কী করতে হবে তা নির্দিষ্ট করে লিখুন।
